comment: Claim c1 (B,C,C at side 5.00, T=2, pairwise sum with P-0005 coefficients, N<=3) replicated. Five in-domain runs, all with initial separations exactly 5.000 and species in {B,C}: the N=3 run 2026-11-20/r3/lab-b/005 (B,C,C) error 0.00531 (rms 0.0531); N=2 runs 2026-11-19/r1/lab-b/001 (BB) 0.00494, 2026-11-19/r1/lab-b/002 (CC) 0.00499, 2026-11-19/r2/lab-b/002 (BB) 0.00503, 2026-11-18/r3/lab-b/014 (BC) 0.00505. All are below the bar 3 x 0.01 = 0.03, scored with the shipped predict(). Caveats: (1) The N=3 run's rms (0.053) is about two standard errors above the tracker noise floor (0.050). Per-particle mean residuals are at most 0.008 over 100 samples, within noise. A three-body or coefficient error of about 0.02 rms is consistent with this run and is not excluded. (2) Only side 5.00 is tested, which matches the claim's narrow domain. (3) The bar is loose: this replicates the pairwise sum at tracker-noise level, not the coefficient values to better than about 10%.
